purpose: Define a measurement-backed ASCII planning artifact that can inspect references cheaply before asset recipes, tool plans, Blender execution, renders, or exports.
producer: future scripts/image_to_ascii_plan_v0.py or manual ASCII drafting

axes.y: depth inferred later by profile, region, or operation hints

field_contracts.status: Source planning status; not a generated asset or render.
field_contracts.source_ref: Reference provenance for the image, sketch, or manual ASCII source.
field_contracts.source_resolution_px: Source image/detail resolution. For serious use, minimum dimension should be at least 960 pixels.
field_contracts.grid: ASCII grid dimensions, cell scale, cell aspect policy, origin, and background glyph.
field_contracts.coordinate_model: Local X/Z measurement model for attaching each character cell to measurable space.
field_contracts.glyph_legend: Meaning of each glyph used by the plan, including whether it marks background, edge, mass, cut, highlight, guide, or label.
field_contracts.ascii_rows: The visible ASCII rows. Every row must have the declared column count.
field_contracts.annotated_cells: Selected cells with source pixel bbox, local X/Z bbox, intensity/edge evidence, role tags, operation hints, and Blender tool hints.
field_contracts.regions: Named groups such as finial, cap, shaft, panel, socket, collar, base, plinth, damage, or ornament.
field_contracts.measurement_policy: Rules that map pixels and ASCII cells into model-space measurements.
field_contracts.blender_tooling_policy: Rules for using ASCII annotations as later Blender tool hints, not direct Blender execution.
field_contracts.source_acceptance: Explicit acceptance/rejection notes. Rejected generated concept images can be recorded here without becoming source.
field_contracts.validation_expectations: Checks that must pass before a plan can be promoted into a source recipe or tool plan.

cell_contract.row_col: Zero-based grid location. The glyph must match ascii_rows[row][col].
cell_contract.source_px_bbox: Pixel-space [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max] from the source image or source planning canvas.
cell_contract.local_xz_bbox_m: Model-space [x_min, z_min, x_max, z_max] covered by the ASCII cell.
cell_contract.brightness: Normalized 0..1 source brightness or planned mass value.
cell_contract.edge_strength: Normalized 0..1 source edge strength or planned edge importance.
cell_contract.edge_direction: Plain term such as vertical, horizontal, diagonal_left, diagonal_right, corner, apex, mass, or none.
cell_contract.geometry_role: Human-readable planned geometry role such as cap_edge, shaft_edge, socket_hint, panel_recess, or plinth_mass.
cell_contract.operation_hints: Geometry dictionary operation terms that may later be used for this cell or region.
cell_contract.blender_tool_hints: Known Blender tool dictionary IDs that may later execute the promoted geometry.

region_contract.bbox_cells: Inclusive row/column min/max bounds for the named region.
region_contract.bbox_m: Model-space [x_min, z_min, x_max, z_max] for the named region.
region_contract.accepted_for_generation: False means reference/guide/rejected-only; true means region may feed future source recipes.

non_goals: This contract does not define a production image-to-ASCII renderer.
This contract does not claim ASCII is final art.
This contract does not generate Blender objects.
This contract does not select final post styles.
This contract does not imply structural, fabrication, historical, or code compliance.
